subject: Mathematics
topic: Centroid, orthocentre, circumcentre, incentre
prompt: Circumcentre of the triangle with vertices (0,0),(4,0),(0,6)?

subject: Mathematics
topic: Centroid, orthocentre, circumcentre, incentre
prompt: The circumcentre lies on a side of the triangle only if the triangle is:

subject: Mathematics
topic: Family of lines through intersection point

options: Put P in the family and solve for λ
Add the intercepts of L₁ and L₂
Equate slopes of L₁ and L₂
explain: Substitute P to get λ = −L₁(P)/L₂(P).

subject: Mathematics
topic: Family of lines through intersection point
prompt: A line of L₁ + λL₂ = 0 passes through the origin when:
explain: Passing through (0, 0) needs the constant term c₁ + λc₂ to be zero.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Family of lines through intersection point

subject: Mathematics
topic: Position of points relative to a line
prompt: For b>0, the region ax+by+c>0 lies on which side of the line ax+by+c=0?

subject: Mathematics
topic: Position of points relative to a line

subject: Mathematics
topic: Position of points relative to a line
prompt: For a>0, the region ax+by+c>0 lies where relative to the line ax+by+c=0?
explain: For a>0, ax+by+c>0 means x > −(by+c)/a, which is to the right of the line.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Position of points relative to a line
prompt: In (ax₁+by₁+c)/√(a²+b²), the value is positive for points on the side:

subject: Mathematics
topic: Distance formula and section formula
prompt: Distance between (a cosα, a sinα) and (a cosβ, a sinβ) is?
explain: Both points lie on x²+y²=a²; the chord is 2a sin(half the angle between them).

subject: Mathematics
topic: Distance formula and section formula
prompt: A point divides AB in the ratio k:1 with k<0 (k≠−1). The division is?
explain: A negative ratio means the point lies outside segment AB, so it is external division.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Area of triangle and collinearity of points
prompt: A triangle has all vertices at integer-coordinate points. Its area is always a multiple of what?
explain: The determinant is an integer, so the area ½·(integer) is a multiple of ½.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Forms of line equation (slope, intercept, normal)
prompt: Area of triangle cut by ax+by+c=0 (abc≠0) with the coordinate axes?
explain: Area = ½·|−c/a|·|−c/b| = c²/(2|ab|).

subject: Mathematics
topic: Distance between parallel lines
prompt: For ax+by+c₁=0, ax+by+c₂=0 with c₁c₂<0, the origin lies:
options: Outside, nearer to the first line
Outside, nearer to the second line
explain: Opposite signs of c mean the origin is between them; d = |c₁|/√(a²+b²) + |c₂|/√(a²+b²).

subject: Mathematics
topic: Distance between parallel lines
prompt: For a point between two parallel lines d apart, the sum of its perpendicular distances to them is:
explain: The two perpendiculars lie along one common normal, so they add up to the distance d.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Foot of perpendicular and image of a point
prompt: Of all points on a line, the one nearest to an external point P is?
options: The point where the line meets PP′ at 45°
The foot of the perpendicular from P
explain: The perpendicular distance is the shortest distance from a point to a line.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Foot of perpendicular and image of a point
prompt: Foot of perpendicular from fixed P to lines through fixed Q lies on which locus?
options: Straight line through P and Q
Circle with centre Q, radius PQ
explain: Angle PFQ = 90° for every foot F, so F lies on the circle with diameter PQ.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Foot of perpendicular and image of a point
prompt: For f(x,y)=ax+by+c, f(P) and f(P′) for a point P off the mirror and its image P′ are?
explain: P′ is on the opposite side at equal distance, so f(P′) = −f(P).

subject: Mathematics
topic: Area of triangle and collinearity of points
prompt: Area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides OP and OQ, where P(x₁,y₁), Q(x₂,y₂)?
explain: Triangle OPQ has area ½|x₁y₂ − x₂y₁|, and the parallelogram is twice that.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Area of triangle and collinearity of points
prompt: A convex quadrilateral has perpendicular diagonals of lengths d₁ and d₂. Its area is?
explain: Each diagonal splits it into two triangles with common base d₁ and heights adding to d₂, giving ½d₁d₂.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Intercepts of a line on coordinate axes
prompt: A line meets the axes at A(a,0) and B(0,b). The length of the segment AB is?
explain: AB is the hypotenuse of the right triangle with legs |a| and |b|. The option |ab|/√(a²+b²) is the distance from the origin.

subject: Mathematics
topic: Angle between two lines
prompt: Angle between x cosα + y sinα = p and x cosβ + y sinβ = q (normal forms) is:

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics
topic: Distance between parallel lines
prompt: Parallel lines pass through A(0,0) and B(3,4). The maximum possible distance between them is:

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics
